TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Upper-body strength with shoulder-friendly loading for climber; pain-free, subacromial impingement considerations"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Baseline strength, mobility & stability":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
        mobility:
          cat_corc 60 seconds
          thoracic_extension 60 seconds
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
          doorway_chest_stretch 60 seconds
          thread_the_needle 2x6 each_side
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
          thoracic_extension 60 seconds
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Progression A + mobility flow":
        warmup:
          jogging_in_place 3 minutes
        mobility:
          scapular_push_up 2x12
          cross_body_stretch 60 seconds
          thoracic_rotation 60 seconds
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
          scapular_push_up 2x12
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Stability, control & mobility":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
        mobility:
          wall_slide 2x10
          band_external_rotation 2x12
          thoracic_opening 60 seconds
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x6..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_mobility 60 seconds
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Deload / technique + mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        mobility:
          spinal_twist 60 seconds
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 2x8..12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 2x8..12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 2x8..12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 2x8..12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 2x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Volume build + mobility primer":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
        mobility:
          doorway_chest_stretch 60 seconds
          thoracic_extension 60 seconds
          thread_the_needle 2x6 each side
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          incline_press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 4x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracicMobility 60 seconds
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Progression B + mobility circuit":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        mobility:
          wall_slides 2x10
          band_external_rotation 2x12
          lat_stretch 60 seconds
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          incline_press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 4x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
          thoracic_extension 60 seconds
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Stability & mobility + shoulder-friendly volume":
        warmup:
          row 5 minutes
        mobility:
          scapular_push_up 2x12
          thoracic_rotation 60 seconds each side
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x6..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          scapular_through 60 seconds
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Deload / mobility emphasis":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        mobility:
          pigeon_pose 60 seconds
          hip_flexor_stretch 60 seconds
          quad_stretch 60 seconds
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 2x8..12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 2x8..12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 2x8..12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 2x8..12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 2x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 60m "strength peak prep + mobility maintenance":
        warmup:
          row 5 minutes
        mobility:
          thoracic_extension 60 seconds
          wall_slide 2x8
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 5x5 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          incline_press 5x5 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          cable_row 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_mobility 60 seconds
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Strength accumulation + mobility flow":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        mobility:
          hip_opening 60 seconds
          thoracic_opening 60 seconds
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 5x4..6 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          incline_press 5x4..6 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          lat_pulldown 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 4x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracicMobility 60 seconds
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Ramp back for peak + mobility prime":
        warmup:
          row 5 minutes
        mobility:
          scapular_through 60 seconds
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x4..6 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          incline_press 4x4..6 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          cable_row 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          face_pull 4x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Testing / Retest readiness + mobility sweep":
        warmup:
          jogging 5 minutes
        mobility:
          thoracic_extension 60 seconds
          pigeon_pose 60 seconds each side
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 1x5 rpe 8
          incline_press 1x5 rpe 8
          dumbbell_row 1x5 rpe 8
          lat_pulldown 1x5 rpe 8
          face_pull 2x12..15
        cooldown:
          mobility sequence 60 seconds

NUTRITION PLAN
  GOAL body_recomposition:
    name "Body recomposition: preserve lean mass, support training, gradual fat loss while maintaining performance"

  DAILY MACROS & CALORIES
    CALORIE_TARGET_TIER "moderate_deficit"
    CALORIE_TARGET
      - baseline 2100
      - adjust_by_activity 200
    PROTEIN_TARGET 1.6x body_weight_kg
    FAT_TARGET 0.8x body_weight_kg
    CARB_TARGET remaining_after_protein_fat

  WEEKLY STRUCTURE
    MEALS_PER_DAY 4
    MEAL_TIMING "pre-workout within 60 minutes of session; post-workout within 2 hours"
    NUTRIENT_DISTRIBUTION
      protein 25-35%
      carbs 40-55%
      fats 20-35%

  NUTRIENT PRIORITIES
    priority_1 "protein intake distributed across 4 meals; aim ~0.4-0.7 g/kg per meal"
    priority_2 "fiber 25-35 g/day; hydration 2.5-3.5 L/day"
    priority_3 "prehab-friendly nutrients: omega-3s, vitamin D, calcium as needed"
    priority_4 "timing: carbs around training; fats moderate away from training window if GI sensitive"

  SAMPLE_DAY
    BREAKFAST "protein-rich oats: oats, whey, chia, berries, almond butter"
    LUNCH "mixed protein bowl: chicken/salmon, quinoa, veggies, olive oil"
    SNACK "greek yogurt or cottage cheese, fruit, nuts"
    POST_WORKOUT "protein shake + banana; fast-dacting carb if workout late"
    DINNER "lean protein, complex carbs, vegetables; optional small casein before bed"

  FOOD_STRATEGY
    - "prioritize whole foods; limit ultra-processed; fasted cardio not required"
    - "include 20-30 g protein per meal; aim 4 meals/day"
    - "hydration: start day with water; monitor urine color as proxy"
    - "adjust calories by 100-200 kcal every 1–2 weeks based on progress"

  SUPPLEMENTS ( Optional )
    - whey_protein
    - vitamin_d
    - omega_3
    - multivitamin
    - creatine_monohydrate 3-5g daily if tolerated

  MONITORING
    - body_weight weekly
    - waist circumference biweekly
    - strength benchmarks at phase transitions
    - symptoms: shoulder pain, ROM, pain with pressing motions

TRAINING-BASED CARDIO
  CARDIO PROGRAM
    GOAL "add cardio 2x/week to support climber endurance and return to long climbing days"
    SESSIONS_PER_WEEK 2
    MODALITIES
      - rowing
      - cycling
    WEEKLY_SCHEDULE
      WEEK 1:
        DAY Tue cardio 25m "Low intensity cardio to build base":
          modality rowing
          duration 25 minutes
          intensity "easy to moderate; conversational pace"
        DAY Thu cardio 25m "Maintenance":
          modality cycling
          duration 25 minutes
          intensity "easy to moderate"
      WEEK 2:
        DAY Tue cardio 30m "Progression":
          modality rowing
          duration 30 minutes
          intensity "moderate"
        DAY Thu cardio 30m
          modality cycling
          duration 30 minutes
          intensity "moderate"
      WEEK 3:
        DAY Tue cardio 30m "Introduce longer base":
          modality rowing
          duration 30 minutes
          intensity "moderate"
        DAY Thu cardio 30m
          modality cycling
          duration 30 minutes
          intensity "moderate"
      WEEK 4:
        DAY Tue cardio 35m "Endurance chunk":
          modality rowing
          duration 35 minutes
          intensity "moderate"
        DAY Thu cardio 35m
          modality cycling
          duration 35 minutes
          intensity "moderate"
    NOTE: Progress tempo to align with climber endurance; if knee/hip issues, substitute walking or elliptical from allowed list. Ensure ascents in climbing days are not impeded; avoid cardio within 2 hours of heavy upper-body workouts if possible to manage recovery.

CLIMBING PREP & HANGBOARD
  CLIMB_PREP
    PHASES_INCLUDED "Phase 2" through "Phase 3"
    NOTES
      - In Phase 2 (weeks 5-8) introduce gentle grip-specific work using safe, shoulder-friendly holds
      - In Phase 3 (weeks 9-12) progress to climbing-specific conditioning and controlled hangboard patterns only if pain-free and cleared by clinician
  HANGBOARD_PROGRESSION
    PHASE "Phase 2 hangboard intro" (weeks 5-8)
      SESSIONS_PER_WEEK 1
      EXERCISES
        - hangboard_assist 3x8..10 rpe 5 rest 120 seconds
        - half_crimp_hang 3x6..8 rpe 5 rest 120 seconds
      NOTES:
        - avoid pain; stop if shoulder irritation arises; use open-hand grips when possible
    PHASE "Phase 3 hangboard+" (weeks 9-12)
      SESSIONS_PER_WEEK 2
      EXERCISES
        - hangboard_pinch 3x6..8
        - half_crimp_hang 3x8..10
        - mix_grip_switch 2x60s
      NOTES:
        - ensure continued pain-free loading; emphasize technique, scapular stability, and controlled tempo

  CLIMB_SPECIFIC_PREP
    ROUTINE
      - technique drills: footwork, body positioning, retz grip control
      - antagonist shoulder activation: external rotation with light resistance 2x15
      - finger/forearm endurance: low-volume, high-frequency grip maintenance on non-fatigue days
      - endurance climbing: easy routes or traverses 1-2 times per week as recovery allows

SATURDAY FINISHER DAY
  SATURDAY_FINISHER
    TITLE "Saturday Finisher Day: Whole-body fun circuit"
    SESSIONS_PER_WEEK 1
    DURATION 60 minutes
    ROUTINE
      - circuit_rounds 3
      - exercises:
          - push_up 3x12..20 rpe 6 rest 30 seconds
          - bodyweight_row 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 30 seconds
          - goblet_squat 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 30 seconds
          - step_up 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 30 seconds
          - hip_thrust 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 30 seconds
          - hanging_leg_raise 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 30 seconds
          - farmer_walk 2x40m rpe 6
      - finisher: 5 minutes of jump_rope or high_knees at easy pace
    NOTES:
      - keep it light and FUN; move with good form; no max effort; scale loads by pain
      - weather: if in gym, substitute with bear_crawl, crab_walk, or inchworm as needed

Notes:
- Intensity push added in Phase 3 to align with peak climber performance; all movements remain within canonical gym-appropriate names; overhead loading still avoided except where pain-free and cleared; Hangboard and climbing prep progressions continue with pain monitoring; Saturday Finisher Day preserves a playful full-body stimulus.

End of summary.
